freezeNote: v1.2 was frozen before any pilot model run. It retains v1.1 matched batching and absent-target scoring, and adds overlay identity-preservation metrics after a pre-run 2025-2026 nearest-neighbor literature audit.
researchQuestion: Does generative overlay grounding improve spatial localization accuracy over direct coordinate prediction?

sample.targetPolicy: Evaluate every planned region and interactive element. Do not remove targets that are absent in the rendered map.

fairnessControls.note: DirectCoord and GridCoord match GOG's region/element separation and maximum batch size to reduce batching confounds.

overlayPreservation.excludeRegion: union of human gold bboxes for targets assigned to the overlay batch, dilated by 5 percent of bbox width and height
overlayPreservation.note: Measure unintended non-target drift. These metrics are audit metrics, not primary superiority endpoints.

goNoGo.go: GOG improves at least two primary metrics over DirectCoord with the same direction on a majority of maps, without a materially worse absentFalsePositiveRate and without severe outside-target drift.
goNoGo.partialGo: GOG does not improve mean IoU but materially lowers missing rate or NCE; reframe the claim around robustness rather than precision, subject to absent-target and overlay-preservation analysis.
goNoGo.noGo: DirectCoord dominates GOG on meanIoUAll, meanNCEAll, recallAt03, and missingRate; or GOG's apparent gains depend on severe non-target image drift. Do not retain GOG as the main contribution without a new mechanism.

auditRules: Do not edit pilot prompts after the first generation run.
Do not tune extraction thresholds on the ten pilot maps after viewing aggregate test metrics.
Record model identifiers, timestamps, raw responses, call counts, and source artifacts.
A verifier API failure is verifier_unavailable, never verified_pass.
Report non-target overlay drift for GOG artifacts; do not hide geometry changes caused by the image editor.
Any protocol change after the first pilot model run requires a new versioned config.
